title: Deferring the Kirby story
summary: The interviewer reminds him of joining Kirby in early 1947, and Holmes suggests saving it for another time.

blocks.x: Then later on, you went back with Kirby.
I went with Kirby, yeah. Let me see...

That was in '47. Well, let me see... Yeah. Yeah, I went with Kirby. Kirby had been trying to get me in his band when I was with Cootie at the Savoy. But nothin' ever come of that, you know. So now, this time Kirby come to the house, and he wants me to go to Washington with him. But I think we'd better wait until some other time.
